claim: Freshly regenerated eligible flat Main/FX graphs receive per-instance Float32 stable-onepole updates. Ten declared composed native programs pass; four actual target compilations retain state layouts. No universal graph accuracy or target CPU claim.
limits: The 33 earlier bounded accuracy programs and ten additional composed programs are distinct declared corpora; neither proves a universal absolute-error bound for arbitrary graphs or amplitudes.

Finite-state safety uses the unchanged helper proof with finite owned inputs/state, IEEE gradual underflow, nearest-even, no contraction and disabled traps; source/type checks do not establish runtime floating environment or pointer ownership.
Fixed fractional cache predicates are preserved. The actual 0.05 bank retains Double conversion/comparison and repeated coefficient work; surrounding oscillator/clock work can also retain Double.
Native host counters and constructor/finalizer stubs do not prove target ELF execution, target library output, live heap/stack or deadlines. Selected arena capacities are structural settings.
No aliases, scalar-data, linear-family, codebox, reset-mode, polyphony, other-rate/vector or optional-optimisation qualification is inherited.

The ten-program study and raw generated captures are archived locally and identified by hashes; this file publishes their plan, authored graphs, results and inventories, not the generated RNBO implementations. The public fresh-graph unit suite independently reproduces compiler admission and wrapper compilation.

native.scope: 10 authored graph programs, strict versus stable references, O3 and UBSan with two independent contexts each. Main filter oracle uses byte-preserved source observer. Native host libc/libm and explicit ctor/fini stubs; not target/ELF execution, whole-host heap tracking, arbitrary graph proof or CPU evidence.

post_inventory_log_prefix.reason: final result line appended after producer inventory; original report retained unmodified

findings: Four fresh actual Xtensa modules compiled/admitted with empty import sets, matching compiler/dependencies/private archives/ABI/state policy for each pair.
Actual DWARF Context and every patch member offset are unchanged, under the intended beta-word to correction-word rename only. Structural arena caps are not measured usage.

Stable six-filter fixed bank retains two Double helper callsites (__extendsfdf2 and __eqdf2) in the original 0.05 literal cache predicate. RN32(0.05) != Double(0.05), so source requires this predicate/update each sample; the adapter preserves it. No full DSP Double-free claim.
Stable Main onepole has one expm1f callsite and no Float64 Hz call edge. Unchanged cycle oscillator and engine clocks retain Float64 helpers; whole Main is not Double-free.
Fresh linked expm1f closures contain only expm1f, hardware-assisted Float32 division, overflow helper and local errno functions. No Float64 helper edge or unresolved closure call.
Static callsites and opcode counts are not dynamic frequency or elapsed cost. All modules are compile-only; independent native audio evidence and prior other-graph target observations are separate.
limits: No device operations, target module loading, execution, output comparison, deadline/stack/heap high-water or CPU measurement.
Manual spill supplements are narrowly bound to exact freshly linked addresses/instructions and caller-private frame ownership; generic conservative auditor gaps remain retained.
These two graphs do not establish all accepted graphs, aliases, nonfinite/fenv behavior or arbitrary manual C++ ownership.
target_compilation.public_metadata_label_normalization: Raw report text_size_delta denotes loaded text span; this publication uses explicit span and .text section names. Raw report is preserved under its recorded SHA256.
